new_value: Implemented: DaoOriginValidator.validate takes an _exact_received_dao_wire provenance snapshot and consumes only a detached parse of that exact wire (python/src/lichen/rpl/dao_origin.py:275-288), so post-provenance mutation of the caller-visible DAO object cannot substitute a different signature option while the transcript uses the original bytes. 751/751 python/tests/test_vectors.py + 751/751 python/tests/rpl pass.
